title: Meaning Of Life
paragraphs: Huh? What did I just hear?
“Huh?”
A million questions were swirling in my mind.
Did he just ask me to kill Father?
“W-Why would I do that?”
“Naofumi-chan!?”
“If you were there, then you must have heard our conversation from somewhere. That’s why, Motoyasu-kun… please, loop again… This time, I want you to save not just us, but also that girl, Raphtalia.”
“But… why does Father have to die for that?”
“That’s because—”
Just as Father was about to explain, I felt something black and ominous rise from his shield.
“Ugh… What is this…? Even the legendary weapons prevent suicide… They’re so meticulously crafted…”
Father spoke while holding the shield, which was now seeping out a black power. He was suppressing some kind of corruption.

This is… the Curse Series…? But why now, of all times? No, Father mentioned suicide prevention. Perhaps the Curse Series has that kind of function as well. Father from the first world once said that heroes must not die. It must be something engraved into the legendary weapons.

“Motoyasu-kun… The reason is simple. It’s what you told me about the conditions for looping. The death of one of the Four Cardinal Heroes or the formation of a barrier by the Four Guardian Beasts… I can’t let you kill Ren or Itsuki, so… I figured if I die…”
Father is trying to force the loop to activate!? Is this world really that hopeless?

“I know it’s extremely selfish… It’s cruel, trampling over the efforts of Ren, Itsuki, so many people… and even you, Motoyasu-kun. But… if it means there are people who can be saved… I’ll gladly… ugh…”
The black aura of the shield grew even more intense. Then, Father transformed it into a shield that looked utterly fragile and raised his head to meet my gaze.

I… I think my hands are shaking more than ever before. My whole body won’t stop trembling. Father is asking me to kill him. Because too many people cannot be saved in this world. He’s trying to sacrifice himself for the sake of the world. And he’s been consumed by the Curse to the point where it’s eating away at his mind.
What am I supposed to do? I want to see Filo-tan. Deep down, I feel like Father is telling me that Filo-tan doesn’t exist in this world.
But… I don’t want to give up.
Is it really okay to sacrifice this world for a better future? That thought weighed heavily on me. Last time, I chose to loop without hesitation because I wanted to see Filo-tan.
But… was that choice really the right one?
“No, Naofumi-chan! You can’t do that! You’re a hero… You’re the hope of this world!”
“Coming from Sadina-san, who’s already accepted death… who wants to die and follow after Raphtalia-chan? Do you really have the right to stop me?”
“We haven’t even confirmed if that girl, Raphtalia-chan, is really dead! Yet you’re already trying to follow after her, Sadina-san… You have no right to stop me!”
“Naofumi-chan!”
“It’s fine. I might die now, but the looped version of me… will still be there. The next me… will figure something out!”
“Why are you so desperate, Naofumi-chan!?”
What am I supposed to do? It feels like my brain is about to overheat.
But… this isn’t the kind of situation I can run away from. Father, resisting the curse, looked down and gazed at the sister.
“When Sadina-san told me, ‘Being protected sometimes makes the one being protected suffer, Naofumi-chan needs to realize that,’ it was people like Sadina-san that made me truly want to do my best.”
Then, Father turned his gaze toward me.

“I was believed in and protected by Motoyasu-kun, Ren, and Itsuki. That’s why I want to live up to that trust. Because everyone believed in me, I wanted to become someone who could protect others. But Sadina-san taught me the pain of being the one protected. Just like yesterday, she unknowingly pushed herself too hard to protect me.”

Oh… this is Father’s anguish as the Shield Hero. Because Father’s power is specialized in protecting, he feels compelled to help everyone. And there are many who want to protect Father, myself included. The sister also mentioned… that those who are protected know that pain as well. Even Filo-tan had a conflicted look on her face whenever Father was hurt. Even if it’s part of the duty and an unavoidable reality, you can’t deny what’s in your heart.
“Sadina-san, earlier, you used the words ‘reason to live,’ right?”
“Y-Yes.”
“Can I… be part of that reason?”
“Huh?”
“If… if it’s truly confirmed that Raphtalia-chan is dead, can I become a reason for you to keep living, Sadina-san?”
At Father’s words, the sister was left stunned, wearing a rare expression of shock.

“Sadina-san, I want to protect you. Just as you tried to protect me… because all I can do is protect! I want to save you from the call of the underworld. If I can’t do that… then even if it means sacrificing this life, my memories, and my feelings… I’ll still see it through!”
As he declared this, Father’s shield released an even darker black aura.
Ugh… this power, I recognize it. Back when I was still deceived by the pig, before we fought the Pope, I fought against Father. This is similar to the power of the Curse I felt back then.
But… the flow of this power feels different from that time.
“Mo-Motoyasu-kun! Hurry, I—!”
…I understand.
Not as a hero, but as a person, Father wants to protect the sister! To achieve that, he’s willing to sacrifice the present. For a better future, this Motoyasu… has made his resolve.
I have fully understood Father’s determination!
“I understand, Father! I will—”
But before I could point my spear forward, the sister wrapped her arms around Father.
“It’s okay now… It’s okay. Naofumi-chan… Motoyasu-chan.”
The sister is crying. Then, she lifts up Father, who can’t stand on his own without support.
“…I understand. Sister, I won’t give up on living. Even if Raphtalia-chan is no longer in this world… I’ll do my best for Naofumi-chan and everyone who’s trying so hard!”
“Ugh… ah…”
Father shakes his head, resisting the shield’s control. Eventually, after hearing the sister’s words, the power of the curse weakens.
“Sa…dina-san. It’s a promise, okay? I… I think that your cheerful side, your care for your friends… those are… wonderful things, so… don’t give up on living.”
“Yeah… yeah…”
The sister embraces Father. Eventually, she and Father, who had suppressed the shield’s power, smiled together.
“I feel… a little better now.”
The sister, regaining her usual self, spoke cheerfully to Father.
“I feel like having a drink. Naofumi-chan, how about a drink?”
“Ahaha, now that’s the Sadina-san I know.”
“Oh? Really?”
The sister wraps her arms around Father’s.
“But take it easy. You’re still not fully recovered from your cold.”
“Oh… cough, that’s right. But I still want a drink.”
“Yes, yes. Just a little, okay?”
“Father, what should we do? Should we loop?”
Father’s words have a point.

“That’s one option… for a better future… It’s true that a lot of things have gone wrong. When I think of the people who have died because of us… that might be the best choice. So, Motoyasu-kun, you have the right to decide.”
“Naofumi-chan.”
The sister’s gaze is slightly stern. She’s right. I agree with her opinion.
“Isn’t it too soon for that now?”
I’m not ready to give up on the present just yet. No matter how bad things are now, I won’t give up until the time comes to decide. I’m sure somewhere under this sky, Filo-tan is waiting for me.
“I understand. Motoyasu-kun, I’m sorry for asking too much.”
“It’s not a problem. I won’t give up on Filo-tan or sister.”
I’m sure this was a necessary step to stop the sister from wanting to die. Magic can be very convenient, but for someone like the sister, it seems she can even harm herself with it.
Ha! My flames of love will never consume me!
That means… my feelings are still not enough, huh?
This means I need to train once again to make my feelings for Filo-tan reach her!
“Oh my, Motoyasu-chan is strong-willed too. I have to make sure I don’t lose to the determination of Naofumi-chan and Motoyasu-chan.”
“Yes… Sadina, please.”
“Okay, okay. I won’t give up anymore. Naofumi-chan, you better be prepared.”
“Yeah.”
Father and the sister exchange glances.
Is it just my imagination? I feel like there’s more intensity in their gaze than before.
“Well then, Naofumi-chan, I’ll rest and regain my strength to get better.”
“I’ll bring you something later.”
“I’m looking forward to it. Also… I want to talk with you tonight, so come after everyone’s asleep. If you don’t come, I’ll come to you.”
“U-uh… okay!”
With that, the sister seemed to have recovered quite a bit and lay down to sleep. Her harsh coughing had completely stopped. This must be that thing… they say illness comes from the mind.
“Sadina-san looks like she’s going to get better. I’m glad.”
“Thanks to Father’s persuasion.”
“I hope so. Alright, Motoyasu-kun, let’s go back to everyone. Then, we’ll make some food to help Sadina-san recover.”
“Understood!”

And so, we returned to where the village’s slaves were. That night, Father went to the sister’s room with a slightly cheerful demeanor. They were probably having a good time, sharing drinks. Just like in the first world, when Father was in a good mood after talking with the sister.
Chapter 745 – Homecoming
It’s the next day.
“Today, we’re planning to take a trip back to the village with Sadina-san and the villagers.”
“Oh, understood. I don’t have any plans, so I’ll come along.”

I haven’t given up on finding my sister. Father and my sister’s sister continue to search, believing that she’s definitely alive somewhere. To strengthen that resolve, they’re probably taking everyone back to the village once.
“So, let’s pack some lunches and head out together.”

Father was using the castle’s kitchen to prepare food for everyone. It seems that a considerable amount of lunch was prepared. Some of the dishes were apparently made with the help of the village’s slaves. Father is still cooking in the kitchen. As we were getting ready to leave, my sister’s sister was cheering up the village’s slaves.
“I’m fully recovered!”

It seems that the slaves understood that my sister’s sister had recovered, and their previously gloomy expressions brightened. As expected, the influence that my sister’s sister has on everyone is immeasurable.
“We should also stop by the village where Imiya-chan’s relatives live later.”
“Ah… yes. I’ve heard that everyone’s doing well. I’m sure they’ll be happy if the Shield Hero visits.”
The mole was occasionally glancing at my sister’s sister.
“Oh? Imiya-chan, is something on your mind?”
“Uh, um…”
The mole seemed flustered and panicked.
What’s the matter?
“I’m just glad you’re better.”
“Yeah! Thanks to Naofumi-chan, I was able to keep going.”
“Yes… I understand.”
“Oh, Imiya-chan too?”
“Yes.”
The mole looked down shyly, while my sister’s sister smiled happily.
“Then we’re comrades. Let’s do our best from now on.”
“Um… yes.”
“Imiya-chan, I’m looking forward to it, okay?”
“Eh? Uh…?”

The mole tilted her head at my sister’s sister’s words. My sister’s sister sometimes says things that don’t make sense. With that, we had Filolial-sama pull the carriage, and we headed to the village. Thinking back, it’s the village that Father had developed in the first world, where I had been taken care of… I’d heard about it, but as expected, it seems to have become a deserted village. To think that Father developed such a ruined village in the first world… he truly is an amazing person. Slowly, we arrived at the deserted village and got off the carriage. The square where the village’s slaves used to run around, Father’s house, Ren, Itsuki, and my house… the illusions of those places seemed to float before my eyes, but that was surely just my imagination. On the outskirts of the village, there was the hut where Filolial-sama used to live… the bioplant fields. Just remembering the differences makes me feel a little melancholic. Father turned his gaze to the village’s slaves. Currently, Melromarc is still suffering from the scars left by the Three Heroes Church and the rampage of the crimson swine. I’ve heard that the contamination of the land still lingers. In this situation, where there are only a handful of villagers left, the mole’s village still has more people.
“Everyone, let’s go visit the graves.”
“Okay!”

I fully understood that this world was different from the first one. The crimson swine and the Three Heroes Church are nothing but a tremendous menace. Father and my sister’s sister gave the slaves the bouquets they had placed on the carriage and then offered them at what seemed to be a grave.
“Next is over here.”

My sister’s sister pointed to what looked like a grave built on a cliff along the coast and offered something with Father. We clasped our hands in prayer. It must be the graves of the people who originally lived in this village.
I felt as though a somber air was lingering. In the midst of that, my sister’s sister raised her hand.
“Okay, everyone, let’s eat the lunch Naofumi-chan prepared in a place with a nice view.”
“Yay!”

Filolial-sama and the slaves all nodded in agreement. Everyone began eating the lunch that Father had prepared, each enjoying it in their own way. The previously somber atmosphere seemed to have dissipated considerably.
“I was feeling a little suffocated. It wouldn’t be good for the villagers to come to the grave with such gloomy faces, right?”
“Well… moderation is necessary, though.”
My sister’s sister sat next to Father and looked at the village’s slaves. Then, she gave a gentle smile.
“It’s a very sad thing, but let’s move forward, okay? Because everyone who survived is still here.”
“Yeah!”
The cheerful atmosphere made even Filolial-sama let out joyful sounds. I was starting to feel cheerful as well.
“Now then, what should we do next?”
It seems the grave visit is over.
Isn’t there nothing left to do but head back?
“Um… I’d like to look around the village a little longer.”
The slaves suggested this. Father and my sister’s sister nodded in response.
“You’re right. It would be a shame to leave so soon after arriving. How about taking a little time to look around the village freely?”
“Thank you very much.”
Is there something that caught their interest? The village’s slaves seemed to be asking in unison.
“Filolial-samas, please make sure these kids don’t get into any danger.”
“Okay!”
Since it’s an abandoned village, we don’t know what’s out there, and it would be a disaster if someone got hurt. We’ll need to keep a watchful eye.
“Maybe I’ll go check on my secret base while I can. I’ve hidden all sorts of things there.”
“Sadina-san’s house?”
My sister’s sister pointed toward the sea.
“There’s an island a little way off the village. It’s my secret base.”

Come to think of it, my sister’s sister’s secret base was on a nearby island. I remember that Father had used that island as a base when he was burning with ambition to conquer the world in the first world.
“I also hid some rare alcohol there, so I’d like to bring it back. Do you think Naofumi-chan and Motoyasu-chan will come along?”
“But… will the kids be okay?”
Sensing Father’s concern, the slaves responded with a smile.
“We’ll be fine!”
“Hero-sama, please go with Sadina-oneesan. She’s still recovering.”
“That’s right! With Filolial-samas here, we’ll be okay!”
“Yeah! Sakura will protect everyone!”
“Is that so? Then I’ll go out for a bit.”
“Alright, I’m off!”
“I’m coming too!”
“I’ll join as well!”
Yuki-chan seems to be coming along too.
“Well then, Naofumi-chan can ride on my back.”
“U-Understood.”
“Come now, Motoyasu-sama, please get on.”
“Understood, I’m ready!”

With that, Father, Yuki-chan, and I followed my sister’s sister as we headed toward the island where her secret base was located. The slaves, meanwhile, were reminiscing about the past in the abandoned village.
“This is my secret base.”

As my sister’s sister guided us, I looked around the island. Yes, this was the place where Father had once been invited in the first world. It’s a crescent-shaped island that seems to have a shallow coastline. It’s not that big. Quite a romantic island. There seems to be a cave on one end of the crescent shape. And in the middle of the crescent, there’s a small grove. If this place was lit up at night, it would be full of atmosphere. It’s a perfect spot for a date with Filo-tan.
“It seems like a great place to visit at night.”
“Y-Yeah, you’re right.”
It seems Father was thinking the same thing as me.
“It’s a lovely island.”
Yuki-chan was gracefully swimming in the shallows.
Oh… the clear water and white sandy beach reminded me of a tropical vacation where I was invited by that pig. I couldn’t care less about the pig, but this island rivals that experience.
“Wouldn’t it be a good idea to invite the Filolial-samas and the slaves from the village here?”
“That might be a good idea. It would be nice for everyone to enjoy a swim.”
“Yeah. If we’ve found such a hidden gem, maybe we should all enjoy it today. Grilling some fish with Motoyasu-kun’s fire magic would be delicious too.”
“Great idea. Naofumi-chan, can you help me bring out the alcohol and supplies from my secret base?”
“Of course.”
“Then I’ll look for something edible while I’m at it, and I’ll go call everyone.”
“Could I ask you to do that?”
“Leave it to me!”
I nodded in response to Father’s request.
